article_summaries.title: Community Event: Ambassador Hide and Seek
article_summaries.summary: An official freerealms.com community event post announcing a Hide and Seek game run by the Community Team Ambassadors in Briarwood on Friday February 19th, 2010, on Server 1 at two times for different regions. Players found hidden Ambassadors by sending duel requests, and the first finder got in-game coin. The page also explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar.

article_summaries.title: Event Recap: Festival of Hearts, Hide and Seek and Beach Party!
article_summaries.summary: A community-team recap of several recent events: a Festival of Hearts semi-formal dance in Merry Vale, an Ambassador Hide and Seek game in Briarwood where finding hidden Community Ambassadors paid coins, and a Seaside Beach Luau where pets could swim. It also explains how to reach community events via the Game Guide calendar and its GO button.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A SOE community news post announcing an All Day Birthday Party for Free Realms' first anniversary, with eight hourly parties in different regions on April 29, 2010 that doubled as Ambassador Hide and Seek games. It explains how to reach community events through the Game Guide calendar and its GO button. The posting date is not printed; it is only given relative to the capture date.

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Ambassador Hide and Seek
article_summaries.summary: A Community Team event in which Community Team Ambassadors hide in Briarwood (from Thistlerow to Briarheart Palace) and players find them by saying hello, with the first finder of each Ambassador receiving in-game coin. The event ran on Server 1 on August 26, 2010 (US/Latin America) and August 27, 2010 (UK/Europe). The post gives a relative age ('5 days, 12 hours ago') rather than a date, so the posting date is unknown.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Spanish-language community event post: Ambassador Hide and Seek, "Posee y Busca a los Embajadores")
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official community event post announcing an Ambassador hide-and-seek event in the Blackspore zone (Esporaumbría in Spanish), run by the Community Team. Ambassadors hid inside the zone and gave clues over Zone Chat; players who found one and sent a trade request received a prize. The post gives the event dates and times for Americas and European regions on Server 1.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A community event page announcing an Ambassador Hide and Seek game in Snowhill, run by the Community Team guild on Server 1 over March 17-18, 2011. Players who spot an Ambassador say hello, and the first finder gets in-game coin; the Ambassador then moves and hides again. Posting date is only given relatively (3 days, 20 hours ago), so the exact date is unknown.
